units.en: Simply play as Netherlands on Historical, and go down the Continue the War in Batavia branch. There is no point in trying to defend your European lands (as Continue the War in Batavia requires you to have capitulated), so build up your Asian possessions. Once Germany is defeated, you will have control of your homeland back, and you can complete Liberation and earn the achievement. Note: You will need to have removed the "Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War" spirit, so make sure you complete War on Pacifism as soon as possible.
Continue the War in Batavia
War on Pacifism
Mi Casa es tu CasaAs Mexico, host a government-in-exile.
Any country is exiled in ⟦0⟧

To host a government in exile you need to be the leader of a faction which has the rule "allows hosting exiled governments". This is set by default on only a small handful of base factions, and the easiest ways to get this achievement (one of which is outlined in the next paragraph) require No Compromise, No Surrender to be enabled. Make your way to Realpolitik and create a "Bastion of Liberty" faction. Use your first initiative point to allow your faction to host governments in exile. Guarantee Finland. Wait for the Winter War to start and accept the Call to Arms. Improve relations and send an attache to Finland. You should have enough relations to invite them to your faction despite the distance. It's important to invite them quickly, as they will white peace the Soviets if they aren't in a faction. Once they capitulate you will get the achievement.
No Compromise, No Surrender

Pride and Extreme PrejudiceSink the British Pride of the Fleet.
Sank the British Pride of the Fleet

It can be done quickly as Japan. The Japanese fleet is immediately capable of sinking not just the HMS Hood, but the entire Royal Navy if played properly. Choose Purge the Kodoha Faction and justify on the UK (or British Malaya) as soon as possible. Ask Germany for docking rights, and move your entire fleet to their port nearest to the UK. Use the bulk of your fleet as a strike force, with three groups of destroyers patrolling the naval areas around the UK. If possible, you can also use naval bombers as well for added firepower. When the justification has finished, declare war on them. If Germany invites you to the Axis you should accept in order to use their airfields. From there just keep beating the Brits and building new ships and bombers (importing Oil for fuel if needed) until your fleet sinks the Hood and unlocks the achievement.
Purge the Kodoha Faction
